= Caption separators
:listing-caption: Listing
:xrefstyle: full

Full: <<figure>>; <<table>>; <<example>>; <<listing>>.

Short: xref:figure[xrefstyle=short]; xref:table[xrefstyle=short]; xref:example[xrefstyle=short]; xref:listing[xrefstyle=short].

Basic: xref:table[xrefstyle=basic].

Overrides: xref:table[Written label.]; xref:labelled[xrefstyle=short]; <<labelled>>.

Exact suffix: xref:repeated[xrefstyle=short]; <<repeated>>; xref:separator[xrefstyle=short]; <<separator>>.

Other endings: xref:period[xrefstyle=short]; <<period>>; xref:spaces[xrefstyle=short]; <<spaces>>; xref:colon[xrefstyle=short]; <<colon>>.

Empty caption: xref:empty[xrefstyle=short]; <<empty>>.

[[figure]]
.Figure _title_
[caption="Figure 9. "]
image::inline-image-dimensions.svg[Figure,width=40]

[[table]]
.Table *title*
[caption="Exhibit 7. "]
|===
|Cell
|===

[[example]]
.Example title
[caption="Résumé 2. "]
====
Body.
====

[[listing]]
.Listing title
[caption="Code A. "]
----
Code.
----

.Labelled title
[example,id=labelled,caption="Exhibit 8. ",reftext="Chosen. "]
Body.

.Repeated suffix
[example,id=repeated,caption="Exhibit. . "]
Body.

Body.

Body.

Body.
